title: A Letter from Bloomhollow
text:
Dearest M. The blossom came early this year and all at once, the whole valley white and pink by Lady Day. The bees are mad for it.

They say the Synod means to send inspectors. Let them come. Nobody can render down an orchard.

Come home before the honey is in. Your loving sister, Hild.

The letter was never sent.
